# HiddenSpots — full site catalog for AI agents

## Summary

HiddenSpots is a personal nature-spot atlas. Users pin springs, waterfalls, trails, and other outdoor places on a map; organize them into collections and trips; log visits; and share selectively via tokenized public links. The product is Hebrew-first (default locale `he`) with English (`en`), RTL-aware, mobile-first, and installable as a PWA with offline map-tile caching.

## Public URLs

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| /he · /en | Marketing landing |
| /he/signin · /en/signin | Sign in |
| /he/signup · /en/signup | Sign up |
| /he/forgot-password · /en/forgot-password | Password reset request |
| /he/privacy · /en/privacy | Privacy policy |
| /he/terms · /en/terms | Terms of use |
| /he/share/{token} · /en/share/{token} | Public share view (noindex) |

## Private app surfaces (auth required — do not index)

- /{locale}/app — interactive map
- /{locale}/locations — location library
- /{locale}/collections — collections
- /{locale}/trips — trip planner
- /{locale}/visits — visit log
- /{locale}/settings — preferences, Drive backup, shares
- /{locale}/import — GeoJSON / KML / GPX import

## Technical notes for agents

- Locales: `he` (default, RTL), `en` (LTR). Always prefer path-prefixed URLs (`/{lang}/…`).
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt
- Manifest: /manifest.json
- Prefer linking to the locale that matches the user; when unknown use `he` (x-default).

## Contact / product positioning

Personal outdoor discovery tool — not a public POI directory. Coordinates for SECRET spots can be fuzzed when shared. Core experience works without microphone, camera, or paid APIs.
